related.title: nftables：分區政策、連線狀態與原子更新
related.titleEn: nftables: segmentation, connection state and atomic updates
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：6與4毫秒可重算，δ另列；未把NTS認證當作時間絕對正確或無非對稱誤差的證明。 交付四時間戳表、偏移/延遲重算與兩階段失敗診斷圖。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 6 and 4 ms and list δ separately; NTS authentication is not claimed to prove absolute time correctness or zero asymmetry error. Deliver the four-timestamp table, offset/delay calculations and a two-stage failure diagnostic diagram.
related.difference: 為管理、教學、資料與訪客四區畫流向圖；每個有向跨區組合測HTTPS與管理服務，另列既有連線回程規則。
related.differenceEn: Map management, teaching, data and guest zones; test HTTPS and management service for every directed interzone pair and separately define established-return behavior.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: NTP偏移估計θ=((t2−t1)+(t3−t4))/2；認證能驗證對端，不能自動消除網路非對稱延遲。 四個合成時間戳以毫秒表示：t1=1000、t2=1018、t3=1022、t4=1028。 θ=(18−6)/2=6毫秒；若t4改1032，其餘不變，θ=(18−10)/2=4毫秒。
不含自連的有向區間測試數=Z(Z−1)S；連線回程必須依狀態解釋，不能把反向新連線與回應封包混為一談。 Z=4區、S=2類服務；本題只數新連線政策組合。 4×3×2=24案；新增一個設備區後5×4×2=40案。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: NTP offset estimate is θ=((t2−t1)+(t3−t4))/2; authentication validates the peer but does not eliminate asymmetric network delay. Four synthetic timestamps in milliseconds are t1=1000, t2=1018, t3=1022 and t4=1028. θ=(18−6)/2=6 ms; changing only t4 to 1032 gives θ=(18−10)/2=4 ms.

Directed interzone test count excluding self-links is Z(Z−1)S; interpret return traffic by state rather than equating replies with reverse new connections. Z=4 zones and S=2 service classes; count only new-connection policy combinations. 4×3×2=24 cases; adding a device zone gives 5×4×2=40.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Suricata EVE：警報、流量與感測器損失
related.titleEn: Suricata EVE: alerts, flows and sensor loss
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：6與4毫秒可重算，δ另列；未把NTS認證當作時間絕對正確或無非對稱誤差的證明。 交付四時間戳表、偏移/延遲重算與兩階段失敗診斷圖。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 6 and 4 ms and list δ separately; NTS authentication is not claimed to prove absolute time correctness or zero asymmetry error. Deliver the four-timestamp table, offset/delay calculations and a two-stage failure diagnostic diagram.
related.difference: 以合成EVE行分開event_type、flow_id、timestamp、sensor與alert action；建立警報到流量的可追溯關係，保留stats損失證據。
related.differenceEn: Separate event_type, flow_id, timestamp, sensor and alert action in synthetic EVE lines; trace alerts to flows and retain sensor-loss statistics.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: NTP偏移估計θ=((t2−t1)+(t3−t4))/2；認證能驗證對端，不能自動消除網路非對稱延遲。 四個合成時間戳以毫秒表示：t1=1000、t2=1018、t3=1022、t4=1028。 θ=(18−6)/2=6毫秒；若t4改1032，其餘不變，θ=(18−10)/2=4毫秒。
輸入位元組率=事件率×平均序列化大小；有警報不等於已封鎖，alert action與實際處置需分開理解。 教學感測器每秒2000事件，平均每事件750位元組；不含傳輸、索引與副本開銷。 2000×750=1500000位元組/秒；事件率增至3000時為2250000位元組/秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: NTP offset estimate is θ=((t2−t1)+(t3−t4))/2; authentication validates the peer but does not eliminate asymmetric network delay. Four synthetic timestamps in milliseconds are t1=1000, t2=1018, t3=1022 and t4=1028. θ=(18−6)/2=6 ms; changing only t4 to 1032 gives θ=(18−10)/2=4 ms.

Ingest byte rate is event rate×average serialized size; an alert does not prove blocking, and alert action must be interpreted separately from actual enforcement. A teaching sensor emits 2000 events/s averaging 750 bytes, excluding transport, indexing and replication overhead. 2000×750=1500000 bytes/s; 3000 events/s requires 2250000 bytes/s.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
